recap.text: Carl recovers a charred glass case from the debris of Miss Quill's falling building. Inside is a plush armoured man atop a black horse named Kimaris. Carl puts the plush and the Sheol Glass Reaper Case in his inventory. He removes Kimaris, then closes the case around a soul gem that is about to flatten the neighbourhood.

Carl uses a Determine Value potion to filter for Unique items and finds a stuffed Kimaris figure on a horse. The System describes the bean bag as a valiant effort to portray Kimaris's scowl. Bautista explains that pulling the tag summons the real creature. Carl's figure is a Unique demon.

Carl measures loot against the stuffed demon on the horse. A ring with two benefits ranks below the Kimaris figure. Pawna's Tears, a potion from the goddess of peace, is the first item valued higher than the figure, and Mordecai tells him to save it.
Shi Maria holds Crawler Carl from the inside and searches his inventory. She finds a summoning totem of Kimaris and asks if Samantha knows. Shi Maria moves on to the potions and a war mage head.

Bautista uses an electronic guidebook to scan Carl's unidentified Kimaris figure. The guidebook identifies Kimaris as one of the brothers of Sheol with a summoning time of the remainder of the floor. Samantha demands the figure, calling him Kimmy, and remembers that he gave her a potion to become pregnant and advised her on dating. Samantha decides she is going to kill his mother.

beats.headline: Rescued from the rubble
beats.text: Recovered from the debris of Miss Quill's building, which is falling in at the time. One of her glass cases, charred and half-buried less than a foot from the explosion, and not broken, so likely enchanted. The char rubs off. Inside is a plush: an armoured man atop a black horse. The tag says Kimaris. Crawler Carl pulls the whole thing into his inventory and runs, and the rest of the building caves in behind him.
beats.gist: Carl recovers a plush of an armoured man on a black horse named Kimaris from debris.

beats.headline: Out of the case
beats.text: Sorted by value, the stuffed horse-riding soldier is the top item in Crawler Carl's inventory, and its glass carrier is the second. The case is a Sheol Glass Reaper Case. It protects against most forms of abuse, and carries a 1.5% chance of Sheol Fire every time it is opened, which Carl reads after opening it. He takes Kimaris out and keeps the case, closes it around a soul gem that is about to flatten the neighbourhood, and sits down to watch.
beats.gist: Kimaris is a stuffed demon horse-riding soldier and Carl's most valuable item.

beats.headline: One of a kind
beats.text: A Determine Value potion lets Crawler Carl see rarity, and he filters for Unique. There is exactly one item. Not the nuke, which is merely Pretty Damn Rare. The stuffed Kimaris figure on the horse. The description reads, in full, that it is impossible to accurately portray Kimaris's usual I-hate-this-and-I-hate-you scowl, but this collectible bean bag makes a valiant effort. That is all the System saw fit to say. It is still the most valuable thing he owns.
beats.gist: A Determine Value potion shows a stuffed Kimaris figure on a horse is Carl's most valuable item.

beats.headline: What a tag does
beats.text: Bautista explains his stuffed animals. Pull the tag, throw it, and after about ten seconds the creature appears and fights for you, or attacks you. A sprite he summoned told him these are true summonings: the real creature, teleported in. Crawler Carl mentions he has one, a dude on a horse named Kimaris. Bautista does not have that one and tells him to hold onto it until he knows its worth. Carl's own reading: his Kimaris figure is a demon, and Unique, not legendary or rare.
beats.gist: Kimaris is a Unique demon stuffed animal on a horse and Carl's most valuable item.

beats.headline: The yardstick for everything else
beats.text: Crawler Carl measures loot against it now. A ring with two benefits on it lands above the Ring of Divine Suffering and below the Kimaris figure. Then Pawna's Tears, a potion from the goddess of peace, becomes the first item he has seen valued higher than the stuffed demon on the horse. Mordecai tells him to save it.
beats.gist: Carl measures loot against the stuffed demon on the horse, which is his most valuable item.

beats.headline: Found by a passenger
beats.text: Shi Maria has hold of Crawler Carl from the inside, and she goes through his inventory the way a burglar goes through drawers. So many things, she says. So many possibilities. Then she stops on one. Kimaris? You have a summoning totem of Kimaris? Does Samantha know this? She moves on to the war mage head and the potions without waiting for an answer, and Carl cannot give one.
beats.gist: Shi Maria searches Carl's inventory and finds a summoning totem of Kimaris.

beats.headline: Still waiting to be scanned
beats.text: Bautista's legendary box gave him an electronic guidebook for his stuffed animals: scan a label, and an info box says what the plush does before you pull the tag. He promised to lend it to Crawler Carl so he could scan the Kimaris figure. Everyone has been too busy. The figure is still in Carl's inventory, still unidentified.
beats.gist: Carl has an unidentified Kimaris figure in his inventory.

beats.headline: Samantha calls him Kimmy
beats.text: At the stairwell Bautista delivers his finding: Kimaris is one of the brothers of Sheol, with a summoning time of the remainder of the floor. Be careful with him. Samantha overhears. Kimmy! she shrieks, and demands him at once. He is one of her best friends. He gave her the potion that let her become pregnant when she could not, and advised her on whom to date. Then she stops, puzzled that she could not remember any of that before. Her conclusion, delivered at volume: she is going to kill his mother.
beats.gist: Bautista delivers Kimaris, a brother of Sheol, to the stairwell. Samantha calls him Kimmy.

relations.note: One of the brothers of Sheol
